descriptions.qa: Answer a specific question from the document, with citations.
descriptions.summary: Summarise the document from passages spread across it.
descriptions.extract: Pull out structured facts (parties, dates, amounts, obligations) as a table.
descriptions.compliance: Check the document against a compliance checklist.
descriptions.general: A question unrelated to the document; answered from general knowledge and labelled as such.

parity.text: Extract all the dates and amounts.

label.description: What this item is, e.g. 'Liability cap' or 'Payment deadline'.

value.description: The value exactly as written, e.g. '£2,500,000' or 'forty-five (45) days'.

source.description: Label of the source it came from, e.g. 'S2'.

quote.description: Short verbatim quote from that source containing the value.

items.title: Documented instructions
items.requirement: The processor processes personal data only on documented instructions from the controller.
items.query: process personal data only on documented instructions of the controller

items.title: Staff confidentiality
items.requirement: Persons authorised to process the personal data are committed to confidentiality.
items.query: personnel authorised to process personal data confidentiality obligation

items.title: Security measures (Art. 32)
items.requirement: The processor takes appropriate technical and organisational security measures.
items.query: appropriate technical and organisational security measures

items.title: Sub-processors
items.requirement: The processor does not engage another processor without the controller's prior authorisation.
items.query: sub-processor subcontract prior written authorisation consent

items.title: Data subject rights assistance
items.requirement: The processor assists the controller in responding to data subject rights requests.
items.query: assist controller respond data subject rights requests

items.title: Breach notification
items.requirement: The processor notifies the controller of personal data breaches without undue delay.
items.query: notify personal data breach without undue delay hours

items.title: Deletion or return at end
items.requirement: At the end of the services the processor deletes or returns all personal data.
items.query: delete or return personal data end of services termination

items.title: Audits and information
items.requirement: The processor makes information available and allows audits by the controller.
items.query: audit inspection rights information to demonstrate compliance records

items.title: Permitted uses and disclosures
items.requirement: The agreement limits the business associate's uses and disclosures of PHI.
items.query: permitted uses and disclosures of protected health information

items.title: Safeguards
items.requirement: The business associate uses appropriate safeguards to prevent unauthorised use or disclosure.
items.query: appropriate safeguards prevent use or disclosure security

items.title: Reporting of breaches
items.requirement: The business associate reports unauthorised uses, disclosures and breaches of unsecured PHI.
items.query: report breach unsecured protected health information unauthorised disclosure

items.title: Subcontractors
items.requirement: Subcontractors that handle PHI agree to the same restrictions and conditions.

items.title: Individual access and amendment
items.requirement: The business associate makes PHI available for access and amendment by individuals.
items.query: access amendment individuals protected health information

items.title: Accounting of disclosures
items.requirement: The business associate provides information for an accounting of disclosures.

items.title: Books and records to HHS
items.requirement: Internal practices, books and records are available to the Secretary of HHS.

items.title: Return or destruction at termination
items.requirement: At termination the business associate returns or destroys all PHI.
items.query: termination return or destroy protected health information
